title: Always Passing
description: is_passing(grade) returns True for grades "A", "B" and "C", and False for anything else. Nobody ever fails...
code:
def is_passing(grade):
    return grade == "A" or "B" or "C"
hint: How does Python group `grade == "A" or "B" or "C"`?
explanation: It reads as `(grade == "A") or "B" or "C"`. A non-empty string is truthy, so when the grade isn't "A" the expression returns the string "B", never False. Compare against each value, or use a membership test: `grade in ("A", "B", "C")`.
